failed_obligation: The exact configured SelfContained suite must pass the Story 18.1 PreparedSource boundary under repository-standard execution, not only as an isolated filter.
observations: The focused PreparedSource boundary passed 119/119 through the same runner before final verification.
The configured suite selected the same 119 PreparedSource cases: 31 passed and 88 failed.
Every class that requires a successfully opened real prepared root failed; fixture-only, tool-projection and pre-open validation cases passed.
All 88 failures were preempted at context issuance by RootUnavailable, while the unique temporary-directory fixture itself created, read and removed its files successfully.

PreparedSource classes have no shared disabled-parallelization collection, while the full SelfContained suite executes many other classes concurrently and the repository already uses such collections for shared expensive or process-sensitive resources.

ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: Full-suite parallel resource/filesystem pressure makes the Windows handle-relative root open unavailable; PreparedSource lacks a declared nonparallel resource boundary.
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: Running all PreparedSource classes in one disabled-parallelization collection will preserve the focused 119/119 result and remove the 88 full-suite RootUnavailable outcomes.

ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: An intermittent host filesystem or security-product interaction denied native root traversal during that run.
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: Isolation will not deterministically correct the suite, and native-status instrumentation would be required after the next bounded stop.

ranked_hypotheses.hypothesis: PreparedSourceTraversal has an intrinsic concurrent P/Invoke defect.
ranked_hypotheses.prediction: PreparedSource-only parallel execution would reproduce the failure, contrary to the existing 119/119 focused evidence.

affected_assumption: Passing the focused PreparedSource selection was assumed to prove it could coexist with the repository's complete parallel SelfContained workload without an explicit resource collection.
changed_approach: Add one PreparedSource disabled-parallelization collection and assign all filesystem-backed PreparedSource test classes to it, preserving test bodies and assertions. Verify the collection/policy metadata, rerun the complete 119-test PreparedSource boundary, then run the exact configured SelfContained suite once.
next_check: The focused PreparedSource selection must remain 119/119 with zero skips and the configured SelfContained suite must pass with zero failures and zero unexpected skips. A failure is cumulative result 10 and pauses without another correction.
summary: The 88 failures are a Story 18.1 test-execution isolation defect at the Windows root-handle seam, not database failures or unrelated historical tests. The exact native status is not retained, but the pass/fail partition and isolated 119/119 run support a bounded test-only nonparallel collection correction before the one authorized rerun.
